_text_key: haven’t had a period since my suction abortion – was the june 3 spotting my period? || hi everyone, i had a suction abortion (manual vacuum aspiration) on **april 19th, 2025**. i was just **1 month and 1 week pregnant** at the time. i’m now over 9 weeks post-procedure, and i still haven’t had a full period, so i’m hoping to get some thoughts or shared experiences. here’s what’s happened: * **post-abortion:** i recovered normally with no pain or heavy bleeding. * on **may 21–22,** i had intense lower abdominal cramps, but they went away after two days. * on **june 3**, i saw some red blood on the tissue paper while wiping after urinating. it looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what i might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. i wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. little cramps but no breast tenderness or pms-like symptoms. * on **june 19**, i had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. i went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal. as of today (**june 24**), i still haven’t had a proper period. i’m not on any birth control, and i don’t have a history of irregular periods or pcos. i do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and i tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(tpo 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(tsh 2.35).** my main questions are: * was the june 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting? * is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion? would really appreciate any insight, especially from people who had delayed periods after surgical abortion. thanks so much.
title: Haven’t Had a Period Since My Suction Abortion – Was the June 3 Spotting My Period?
body:
Hi everyone,

I had a suction abortion (manual vacuum aspiration) on **April 19th, 2025**. I was just **1 month and 1 week pregnant** at the time. I’m now over 9 weeks post-procedure, and I still haven’t had a full period, so I’m hoping to get some thoughts or shared experiences.

Here’s what’s happened:

* **Post-abortion:** I recovered normally with no pain or heavy bleeding.
* On **May 21–22,** I had intense lower abdominal cramps, but they went away after two days.
* On **June 3**, I saw some red blood on the tissue paper while wiping after urinating. It looked like a small amount of fresh blood — similar to what I might see on day 3–4 of a typical period — but it only lasted half a day. I wore a pad, but there was no blood on it at all. Little cramps but no breast tenderness or PMS-like symptoms.
* On **June 19**, I had another episode of strong cramping and pulsating pain in the lower abdomen, along with intense pain in the pelvic region during bowel movements. I went to the clinic the next day, where they performed all the necessary tests and an ultrasound, and said everything looked normal.

As of today (**June 24**), I still haven’t had a proper period. I’m not on any birth control, and I don’t have a history of irregular periods or PCOS. I do have subclinical hypothyroidism, and I tested positive for **thyroid peroxidase antibodies** earlier this year **(TPO 60)**, but my thyroid levels were said to be in the normal range recently **(TSH 2.35).**

My main questions are:

* Was the June 3rd spotting likely my first period, or just hormonal spotting?
* Is it normal to still not have a period more than 9 weeks after a suction abortion?

Would really appreciate any insight, especially from people who had delayed periods after surgical abortion. Thanks so much.

title: Miscarriage 5w5d? Need advice
body:
Hi everyone,

I’m hoping to hear from anyone who’s been through something similar. This has been such an emotional rollercoaster, and I feel like I’m stuck in limbo.

I recently found out I was pregnant. At around 5 weeks 3 days, I started spotting brown on a Monday and by Wednesday night I started seeing red blood when I wiped only. Next morning I woke up with my shorts pretty much soaked in dark red blood went straight to the ER. It lasted about 12–18 hours—like a period, but I haven’t passed any clots. After that, the bleeding tapered off to mostly light spotting that’s dark red or brown (mostly brown when I wipe only). The liners I’ve been using barely have any spotting on them. I haven’t had any pain at all, just fatigue similar to early pregnancy.

        •        Monday: 725
        •        Thursday(at the ER):2,665

The ER paperwork said they couldn’t confirm if it was an ectopic pregnancy, a very early miscarriage, or something else. An ultrasound didn’t show a sac in my uterus, but they did see cysts on my ovaries. They said if hCG keeps rising, ectopic is still a possibility.

It’s so confusing because my hCG went up quite a lot, and I still feel pregnant. Part of me wonders if this is just how a chemical pregnancy looks.

Has anyone experienced something similar—bleeding early on with rising hCG, no clots, and no sac visible on ultrasound? Did it turn out to be ectopic, a miscarriage, or a viable pregnancy? I would really appreciate hearing any stories.

title: MMC, D&C, then Chemical Pregnancy?
body:
I found out in March - when I was supposed to be 11 weeks pregnant - that it was fetal demise and development stopped around 8 weeks. 
I thought I miscarried naturally by the amount of bleeding/cramping I experienced immediately after. However, in May I began having intense bleeding and cramping again. Surprise! Ultrasound showed the fetal tissue fully retained. After a month of pain and bleeding, I finally had a D&C. Bled for a week after that.. had 5 days of no bleeding and finally feeling better.. and BOOM, my first period showed up with a vengeance. 
After a rough 9 day period.. I think I had a normal cycle. However, I definitely had “TTC fatigue” after the 6 month long failed pregnancy and didn’t track things closely. 
Last week, as my period due date drew near, I started having nausea after my coffee… took an early detection test- faint positive. Took a second one the next day.. still faint, but still positive. 
Then that night, I started having some spotting, which turned into A LOT of tissue, then into raging bleeding. 
Is this just a chemical pregnancy? Was my uterine lining still too unstable after the D&C? Could something be wrong inside? 
I have an appointment next week for an ultrasound, but my doctors office gave me zero info over the phone. 
Feeling pretty defeated and devastated at the thought of 2 miscarriages back to back. 

Anyone else experience a chemical pregnancy immediately after a D&C?
